CompletionText.SourceString: Tracking down the bandits wasn’t easy. They didn’t stay in one place, just as the merchant had warned. I scoured the roads and outskirts of the village. The bandits were as dangerous as he had described, armed to the teeth and ready for a fight. After a tough battle, I managed to defeat them and clear the area of their threat. It wasn’t easy, but the village would be safer now.
